A size\'s capacity is its usual one at a light load: a heavy one gets less out of it, an alkaline\'s most of all.
IEC 60086\'s names of the alkaline (LR) or lithium (CR) cells. The 9V is height × width × depth. Li-ion cells are named by their size: 18650 is 18 mm across and 65 mm long.
CR: lithium, 3 V; its digits are its size (CR2032 is 20 mm across, 3.2 mm thick). Capacities differ by maker and load.
